About the Wenatchee Valley Velo Saturday Ride group ride

The Wenatchee Valley Velo club's weekly Saturday road ride, usually rolling from Wenatchee Valley Brewing Company. Rides are rated A, B or C by pace and by terrain. Exact times and routes are posted on the club's events calendar. The club also puts on some weeknight rides in season.
